name: Melmetal
flavor: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

ability.name: Metal Scrum
ability.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in play, all of your [M] Pokémon take −20 damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon. This effect doesn’t stack.
